Carrier checks for animal travel

Use this note when you are getting ready to move a pet through Aurelia Skyways. Keep the carrier close, steady, and clean, and watch the animal for stress before you leave home. The Companion Animal Travel Desk checks each case with care, because a calm start makes the rest of the trip easier.

Bring the carrier that matches the trip plan and make sure the latch works the way it should. <<FACT F085>> Place bedding inside if it stays secure, and remove anything loose that could shift or snag. Food, water, and comfort items should be simple and safe, with nothing sharp, noisy, or breakable in the space.

Staff will look at the animal's size, behavior, and general comfort before the handoff. Trained handlers give patient attention and adjust the care plan when the pet seems nervous, warm, or restless. If the animal needs extra support, say so early so the record is clear and the trip stays orderly.

Keep your travel papers together and present them without delay when asked. <<FACT F103>> If the carrier needs another review, stay nearby and wait for the next instruction from the desk. Do not open or seal the carrier again unless a staff member tells you to do it.

For a smooth check, arrive prepared, speak plainly, and keep the pet calm through the handoff. Aurelia Skyways relies on clean records and careful handling, so even small details matter. If anything changes with the animal before departure, tell the Companion Animal Travel Desk right away.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.
